worldRules.name: Reverberation
worldRules.description: A left-side echo pulses; move into the central lane.

worldRules.name: Glass Shelter
worldRules.description: Breakable northern cover intercepts ordinary projectiles.

worldRules.name: Migrating Vents
worldRules.description: Vents alternate north and south; the central lane stays safe.

worldRules.name: Ash Tides
worldRules.description: The south terrace burns after its warning.

worldRules.name: Hollow Watch
worldRules.description: A northern gaze pulses after its warning.

worldRules.name: Crown Toll
worldRules.description: Side pillars pulse; pass through the broad central lane.
